My tweets, with timestamps:

`9:54 AM · Jun 23, 2019`

At least 50 people waiting at Panmure station, lots of families going to the city. First unofficial stop of my #AklTransitChallenge

`10:08 AM · Jun 23, 2019`

Lots of people already on the train, and more on at GI and Meadowbank. Oohs and aahs for the tunnel and going over the water. Someone's playing music further down with some singing along. 

`10:25 AM · Jun 23, 2019`

Big family/friend group (25 or so, with prams) getting off at Britomart, taking a photo next to the train. 1 Must not have been on a train before 2 May not have been to the city before. Such a good outing and probably no other way to do it except free trains. #AklTransitChallenge

`10:19 AM · Jun 23, 2019`

It begins! #AklTransitChallenge

![](/img/akltc2019/tc1.jpg){width="80%"}

`10:35 AM · Jun 23, 2019`

Front row seat to Albany. Older double decker, a bit different from the 70 I usually get. Seems smaller maybe. Little guy sitting next to me (with his mum behind) staring at everything. #AklTransitChallenge 

`10:38 AM · Jun 23, 2019`

Akoranga. Didn't expect to need sunglasses today, sun is blazing on the shore. #AklTransitChallenge

`10:56 AM · Jun 23, 2019`

Albany! Having doubts about my plans. Just going to wing it. Big lines for the bus, not going to get a front seat this time. #AklTransitChallenge

![](/img/akltc2019/tc2.jpg){width="80%"}

`11:06 AM · Jun 23, 2019`

Albany constellation 120 Henderson Swanson Britomart eastern southern Onehunga
- Or - 
Albany Britomart west 68 Onehunga southern eastern 
Both require some doubling up, either Parnell twice or ellerslie to Newmarket twice.

`11:09 AM · Jun 23, 2019`

Double decker from Albany completely full. Sorry kid, I didn't bring enough kit kat for everyone. Think he nearly cried seeing me putting it away. #AklTransitChallenge

`11:40 AM · Jun 23, 2019`

Eastern line train just arrived, full of people. So many families. #AklTransitChallenge Western line pulling in as I get to the platform, 8 minute wait. Good to see most trains are 6 cars.

![](/img/akltc2019/tc3.jpg){width="80%"}

`12:15 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

Interesting to be passing by people's backyards on the western line. Reminds me of Wellington trains, but not quite so orderly with the road layout. #AklTransitChallenge

`12:22 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

I don't know why my Snickers is feisty.

![](/img/akltc2019/tc4.jpg){width="80%"}

`12:36 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

Swanson! Changing carriers because I can. We seemed to have picked up some sparrow passengers, hopefully temporarily. #AklTransitChallenge

![](/img/akltc2019/tc5.jpg){width="80%"}

`12:45 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

Chasing the rain back into town. Train is going to be full again.

`1:02 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

Train is full-ish. Looks like 68 is a good bet to get to Onehunga. Unsure if it's a good bet getting from Onehunga to southern. We'll see. #AklTransitChallenge

![](/img/akltc2019/tc6.jpg){width="80%"}

`1:11 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

Plenty of people off and on at New Lynn. Have found the rain again. Found some lunch, and some infamous public art. #AklTransitChallenge

![](/img/akltc2019/tc7.jpg){width="80%"}

![](/img/akltc2019/tc8.jpg){width="80%"}

`1:48 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

68 was weird but effective. Onehunga! Train waiting on the platform so jumped straight on. People discussing where they want to go, might as well go eastern line, just because. #AklTransitChallenge

![](/img/akltc2019/tc9.jpg){width="80%"}

`2:03 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

Newmarket, for the second time today. #AklTransitChallenge

`2:53 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

Feels like a quick trip to Papakura, but maybe I've been riding buses and trains all day. 22 minute wait for Pukekohe train. Maybe the southern was a bit late getting in? #AklTransitChallenge

`3:01 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

I do not miss these noisy smelly bois. Standing room only coming in from Pukekohe. Much less leaving from Papakura but seems like we're just gonna wait for a little while.

![](/img/akltc2019/tc10.jpg){width="80%"}

`3:38 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

Pukekohe! On the way back, with a little detour through Manukau. #AklTransitChallenge

![](/img/akltc2019/tc11.jpg){width="80%"}

`3:48 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

With transfer time at Papakura, quicker to get on the 33 to get to Manukau.

![](/img/akltc2019/tc12.jpg){width="80%"}

`4:24 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

I don't think this bus driver knows that I am in a rush. Go Go Go!

`4:40 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

Yeah, don't think I was going to make that connection anyway. 15 minutes until the last leg of the journey. #AklTransitChallenge

![](/img/akltc2019/tc13.jpg){width="80%"}

![](/img/akltc2019/tc14.jpg){width="80%"}

`5:40 PM · Jun 23, 2019`

Britomart! #AklTransitChallenge 
7h15m for an outing literally all across Auckland. #AT100Million

![](/img/akltc2019/tc15.jpg){width="80%"}
